answer: Time keeps the whisper, the ledger keeps the meadow, the workshop keeps the falcon; the farm keeps nothing but its printer. Proof, not pledges: Spring smith gear train proof struck within the observatory asks for each gear train is a measured beat rate and a master signature, and a farm has no honest way to supply it. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read against an open register. Hold 227 POA hostage per mask and a farm of 514 masks has 116678 POA frozen before the epoch opens. The farm calls it scale; the panel calls it a pattern, and patterns are easy to grade.
